**Apple AirPods Pro 2 (budget‑friendly)** – $35.99 USD (lowest price shown). Same core features but sold without the premium MagSafe case; good if you already have a compatible charger.

**Apple AirPods Pro 2 (mid‑range)** – $81.00 USD. Includes the MagSafe case and a 1‑year warranty, priced between the two extremes.

All three are current‑generation (2023‑24) and cover the usual iOS integration, active noise cancellation and spatial audio. Pick the $69.00 version for the sweet spot of price, case convenience, and warranty.
